    Extriangulated categories, triangulated embeddings and algebraic realizations #

    This file uses only Mathlib. It fixes the general vocabulary of the manuscript An extriangulated category with no triangulated embedding:

    • ExtriangulatedData k C: an extension bifunctor E on a k-linear category C, with values in k-modules, and a realization predicate Realizes δ x y ("the sequence A -x→ B -y→ C realizes δ ∈ E(C, A)").
    • ExtriangulatedData.IsExtriangulated: the axioms (ET1)–(ET4) and (ET4)ᵒᵖ of Nakaoka and Palu [NP, Definition 2.12]. The realization 𝔰 of [NP] is encoded by the predicate: every extension is realized, two realizations are equivalent, and realizations are closed under equivalence.
    • ExtriangulatedFunctor: an extriangulated functor into a pretriangulated category in the sense of Bennett-Tennenhaus and Shah [BS, Definition 2.32, n = 1], as recalled in the introduction.
    • ExtriangulatedFunctor.IsTriangulatedEmbedding, HasAlgebraicRealization.
    • ExactStructure, ExactStructure.IsFrobenius, IsAlgebraicTriangulated.

    The definition of an algebraic triangulated category ("triangle equivalent to the stable category of a Frobenius exact category") is stated through the quotient functor: a Frobenius exact category B and an additive functor Φ : B ⥤ T which is full, essentially surjective, kills exactly the morphisms factoring through a projective object, and carries connecting morphisms natural in morphisms of conflations which complete the images of conflations to distinguished triangles.

    Type (max (max (max (t + 1) u) v) w)

    An extension bifunctor with values in k-modules together with a realization predicate.

    • E : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (CategoryTheory.Functor C (ModuleCat k))

      The extension bifunctor E(C, A), contravariant in C and covariant in A.

    • Realizes {A B C' : C} : ↑((self.E.obj (Opposite.op C')).obj A) → (A ⟶ B) → (B ⟶ C') → Prop

      Realizes δ x y: the sequence A -x→ B -y→ C realizes δ ∈ E(C, A).

                                                def ExtriangulatedRealization.Statement.IsAlgebraicTriangulated (T : Type u') [CategoryTheory.Category.{v', u'} T] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive T] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject T] [CategoryTheory.HasShift T ℤ] [∀ (n : ℤ), (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor T n).Additive] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated T] :
                                                Prop

                                                A triangulated category is algebraic if it is triangle equivalent to the stable category of a Frobenius exact category. We state this through the quotient functor Φ : B ⥤ T: it is additive, full and essentially surjective, a morphism goes to zero exactly when it factors through a projective object, and conflations go to distinguished triangles with connecting morphisms natural in morphisms of conflations.
